const patch = "*** Begin Patch
*** Add File: /app/output/gen.py
+"""Single-session operator console for the RoboLab limited-mode episode.
+
+Start with `python -u /app/output/gen.py`. It creates exactly one Robot client,
+captures the initial observation, then accepts Python statements on stdin with
+`r`, `np`, `capture`, and `act` available. All observations/actions are saved
+under /app/runs for the trajectory record.
+"""
+import json
+import pathlib
+import traceback
+
+import numpy as np
+from rcb_client import Robot
+
+OUT = pathlib.Path("/app/runs")
+OUT.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
+print("Connecting to RoboLab service...", flush=True)
+r = Robot()
+spec = r.spec()
+(OUT / "spec.json").write_text(json.dumps(spec, indent=2))
+print("Connected.")
+print(json.dumps({k: spec.get(k) for k in ("protocol", "control_hz", "action_types", "default_cameras", "world", "robot_spec", "proprio_layout", "proprio_groups", "budget", "cameras")}, indent=2), flush=True)
+
+_count = 0
+
+def _next(label):
+    global _count
+    _count += 1
+    return OUT / f"{_count:03d}_{label}"
+
+def capture(label="observe", depth=True, seconds=0.0):
+    p = _next(label)
+    o = r.get_obs(depth=depth, seconds=seconds, video="frames")
+    o.save(str(p))
+    print("OBS", json.dumps(o.meta, default=lambda x: x.tolist() if hasattr(x, "tolist") else str(x)), flush=True)
+    print("SAVED", p, "cameras", list(o.last), "depth", list(o.last_depth), flush=True)
+    return o
+
+def act(kind, actions, dt=None, label="action", video="frames", video_fps=5, depth="last", note=""):
+    p = _next(label)
+    res = r.submit(kind, actions, dt=dt, video=video, video_fps=video_fps, depth=depth, note=note)
+    res.save(str(p))
+    print("RESULT", json.dumps(res.meta, default=lambda x: x.tolist() if hasattr(x, "tolist") else str(x)), flush=True)
+    if res.meta.get("proprio"):
+        print("PROPRIO_NOW", json.dumps(res.meta["proprio"].get("now")), flush=True)
+    print("SAVED", p, "frames", {k: len(v) for k, v in res.frames.items()}, flush=True)
+    return res
+
+def pose_now(o=None):
+    if o is None:
+        o = r.get_obs(video="none")
+    names = spec.get("proprio_layout", [])
+    now = np.asarray(o.meta["proprio"]["now"], dtype=float)
+    return {name: float(val) for name, val in zip(names, now)}
+
+print("Capturing initial observation...", flush=True)
+initial = capture("initial", depth=True)
+print("PROPRIO_LAYOUT", json.dumps(spec.get("proprio_layout")), flush=True)
+print("PROPRIO_NOW", json.dumps(pose_now(initial)), flush=True)
+print("Ready. Enter Python statements; use capture(...) and act(...). Type quit to stop.", flush=True)
+while True:
+    try:
+        line = input("rcb> ")
+    except EOFError:
+        break
+    if line.strip() in {"quit", "exit"}:
+        break
+    if not line.strip():
+        continue
+    try:
+        exec(compile(line, "<operator>", "exec"), globals(), globals())
+    except Exception:
+        traceback.print_exc()
*** End Patch";
